price_basis: Yahoo adjusted OHLC: raw OHLC multiplied by Adj Close / Close
execution: signals from date t close; target exposure filled at date t+1 open
risk_free_rate: prior available DGS3MO observation converted from annual yield to daily rate

signal_parameters.MACD: EMA(12)-EMA(26), signal EMA(9); long when MACD > signal
signal_parameters.KDJ + RSI: KDJ(9,3,3), RSI(14); enter on K cross above D with K<30 and RSI<50; exit on K cross below D with K>80 or RSI>70
signal_parameters.ZMR: 20-session close z-score; enter at z<=-2; exit at z>=0
signal_parameters.Buy & Hold: 100% target exposure from first session open
